tasks.short: Supervise and develop counselling staff and interns

steps.what: Supervise, train, and direct professional staff and interns

tasks.design: Keep supervision with the counsellor, using authorised reference material in {DOCS} when needed. No automated assessment of staff competence or substitute for observed practice is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision depends on context, candour and observation of professional conduct.
tasks.enabler_now: No new technical capability changes the central work of this task.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising when a trainee needs closer oversight or a different learning approach.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor can challenge unsafe practice while preserving a working relationship.
tasks.altitude: Supervision time and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Recognise a situation requiring supervisor intervention
reach.learn: Escalation thresholds and limits of delegated work

evidence.claim: Professional supervision requires contextual feedback and observation; this unchanged design claims no time saving.

assumptions: Boundary is direct supervision and training, not a separate scheduling or staff-record task.
The counsellor produces guidance through the conversation; no structured machine input is required.
Test existing reference access in native systems before considering any future build.
Zero upkeep is justified because no new process, software or maintained dataset is introduced.
unknowns: Local supervision responsibilities and staff mix
research_questions: Which supervision problems arise from missing information rather than a need for closer professional oversight?

already_counted.description: Observation, feedback and direction remain the entire task

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100; gross and net saving are zero. Both ordinary and difficult supervision retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interview clients about backgrounds, career goals and employment barriers

steps.what: Interview clients about employment history, educational background, goals and barriers

tasks.design: Keep the interview with the counsellor and client. Reference prompts in {DOCS} can support coverage, but do not replace listening or reduce the interview allocation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clients may not initially know how to describe a barrier or may hesitate to disclose it.
tasks.enabler_now: Recording-to-note tools exist, but do not establish that this interview can safely be shortened.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing a tentative preference from a stable objective and exploring sensitive barriers.
tasks.human_edge: A trusted interviewer notices hesitation, changes pace and checks understanding.
tasks.altitude: No change to interview time or decision rights.

reach.task: Explore whether an employment barrier needs specialist support

evidence.claim: Magic Notes drafts case notes and assessments from recorded council social-work visits; that is documentation capability, not evidence of shorter career interviews.
An interview requiring trust and clarification has no demonstrated saving in this proposed unchanged workflow.

assumptions: Boundary is interviewing; formal case-record maintenance belongs to its own task and earns no saving here.
The client provides narrative information and the counsellor clarifies it in s1; no automatic structured-input contract is assumed.
Existing native interview prompts should be reviewed before any custom tool.
No recording, model service or new data collection is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Interview accessibility needs and typical complexity
research_questions: Would changing preparation improve interview quality without suppressing useful disclosure?

already_counted.description: Listening, clarification and exploration of barriers

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and upkeep=0 give zero net saving. Both straightforward and sensitive interviews retain their time; documentation benefits are outside this boundary.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compile and study information for vocational and educational objectives

steps.what: Select occupational, educational, and economic sources and record relevant facts
Compile selected information into a comparison brief
Study the brief and assess relevance to counselees' objectives
Explain information and help counselees consider feasible objectives

tasks.design: Configure a structured table and comparison view in {DOCS} to assemble entries selected by the counsellor. Retain source selection, interpretation and discussion; the view quotes entered facts and marks missing fields rather than predicting career suitability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected information is repeatedly copied into comparable headings.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tables and reusable views can assemble already checked entries without semantic generation.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting labour-market evidence and determining whether an option fits a person's circumstances.
tasks.human_edge: The counsellor explains uncertainty and weighs preferences that a comparison table cannot resolve.
tasks.altitude: Less time formatting comparisons; career guidance authority remains unchanged.

reach.task: Maintain a source-linked educational options directory
reach.learn: Source dates, eligibility caveats and correction procedures

evidence.claim: Native structured document tables can produce consistent comparison views from selected fields; the time allocation is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary starts at a guidance question and ends with interpretation and discussion of researched information, not client eligibility decisions.

Counsellor in s1 produces title, source reference, publication date, retrieval date, location, quoted requirement, amount or rate with units and period, caveat and topic. Its full 35 hours include capture and checking.

The s2 view uses only those entries, preserves units and dates and shows unknown fields explicitly. Missing or incompatible data return to manual compilation; no extraction or external feed is assumed.
Try native table and view configuration before custom code; existing search/runtime earns no savings.
Any overlap with a separate course-directory task must be assigned once in a team roll-up.
unknowns: Current compilation effort and availability of native table views
research_questions: Can a trial brief preserve every qualification, unit and source date while reducing manual assembly?

incremental.description: Maintain fields and view rules, check broken references and resolve exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100 and R=80 give gross 20, less 3 upkeep gives central net 17. High assumes the full 20-hour assembly step is repeatable. Low assumes only 3 hours of assembly removed, consumed by upkeep; source evaluation and counselling never shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Build employer contacts for student internships and employment

steps.what: Establish contacts with employers and discuss internship and employment opportunities

tasks.design: Keep employer contact and negotiation with the counsellor through {EMAIL} and {TELEPHONY}. Use existing contact information where available, without inventing a separate matching or automated outreach stage.
tasks.previous_blocker: Creating opportunities requires trust, an understanding of student needs and an employer's willingness to participate.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing communication channels support contact but do not remove relationship-building effort.
tasks.still_hard: Securing meaningful, accessible placements and candid employer feedback.
tasks.human_edge: The counsellor can negotiate expectations and recognise when a proposed opportunity would not serve students.
tasks.altitude: No change to contact work or power to promise placements.

reach.task: Support agreed employer follow-up without promising placements
reach.learn: Contact permissions and escalation of suitability concerns

evidence.claim: Employer relationship-building depends on reciprocal communication; existing communication software does not itself establish incremental labour savings.

assumptions: Boundary is establishing employer contacts; placement administration and student assessment are separate tasks.
Counsellor and employer produce the opportunity understanding in s1; there is no machine step relying on unproduced vacancy fields.
Review existing native contact functions before proposing future custom tracking.
No automated outreach or new maintained database is introduced; incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Existing employer network and placement agreements
research_questions: What prevents an employer conversation from becoming a suitable opportunity?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100 with zero upkeep give zero net saving. Existing and new employer relationships retain their contact time; no administrative baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Spend less time assembling researched comparisons while retaining interviews, supervision and employer relationships.
reach: Help support staff maintain source-linked educational information within agreed access boundaries
role.ambitious_version: A counsellor who can show the evidence behind options while keeping personal guidance and commitments accountable.

job.title: Educational, Guidance, and Career Counselors and Advisors
